module: "Hologram column" checkpoint marker: a single central column (s_single_faded_column_rect.dae) placed on the ground by raycast, colored according to the mode, that lengthens with distance and oscillates slightly. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/singleHologramMarker')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: setToCheckpoint(wp) reads wp.pos, wp.radius, wp.normal (default (1,1,0) normalized), wp.fadeNear, wp.fadeFar, wp.minAlpha.

Colors per mode: default blue (0, 0.4, 1), next black (column thinned to 0.75), start and lap green (0.4, 1, 0.2), recovery yellow (1, 0.85, 0), final blue (0.1, 0.3, 1), branch orange (1, 0.6, 0), hidden thins to 0. 0.8 s fade between two modes.
The ground is found with Engine.castRay (6 m above, 25 m below) by temporarily disabling forest collision; if the ground is more than 1 m below the original position, the original position is kept.
The column's alpha is clamp((distance - 60) / 60, 0.15, 1): more visible from afar.
update crashes if called before setToCheckpoint (centerPos nil); scenario_race_marker always calls setToCheckpoint first.
The extracted page shows update(dtSim); the actual signature is update(dt, dtSim).

update.desc: Per-frame call: fade, color, alpha and column height according to distance, oscillation.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Places the column on the ground below the checkpoint.

setMode.desc: Changes mode: shows (except 'hidden') and starts the fade.

mode.desc: default, next, start, lap, recovery, final, branch or hidden.

createObject.desc: Creates a hidden TSStatic registered under objectName and added to ScenarioObjectsGroup.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old object then creates the column.

clearMarker.desc: Removes an object from its identifier.
